title: USF-195/USF-204 SonarQube Service Semantic Proof Boundary

remainingProofBoundary.riskStatement: USF-204 proves bounded local Compose scan semantics but must not be overclaimed as operator UI, policy administration, human hotspot workflow, OIDC plugin depth, environment readiness, or live-provider readiness.
remainingProofBoundary.treatment: retain explicit deferrals for UI clickthrough, policy administration, hotspot human review, OIDC plugin depth, and environment promotion semantics while accepting bounded local Compose proof for scanner submission and service readback
requiredEvidence: operator console UI clickthrough proof remains USF-169 or later gateway/operator issue
quality-gate policy administration evidence remains deferred
security hotspot human review workflow remains deferred
sonar-oidc-plugin bootstrap and identity integration evidence remains deferred
environment promotion semantics remain USF-193 governed

operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.operatorAccessBoundary: USF-204 validates authenticated local API access for the SonarQube proof credential; browser UI clickthrough and public exposure are not claimed.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.auditRequirement: proof emits value-free audit-shaped evidence only; production operator-action audit is not claimed
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.retentionBoundary: USF-204 deletes the temporary synthetic project and revokes the temporary credential after proof; no scanner payloads are retained as readiness evidence.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.secretBoundary: No SonarQube credential, token value, raw endpoint, provider payload, scanner log, or connection string is emitted in proof evidence.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.supplierBoundary: Local generated Compose service metadata and local scanner proof are not supplier or live-provider evidence.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.incidentBoundary: No production incident, vulnerability-response, or corrective-action workflow is proven by USF-204.

localVerificationGate.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Repository validation commands remain mandatory local deterministic verification evidence, but they are not equivalent to SonarQube service history, dashboards, issue lifecycle, security hotspot workflow, scanner execution, or quality-gate operations.

composedProof.sdkSelectionRationale: @sonar/scan is the official SonarSource npm scanner package, currently stable at 4.3.8, with TypeScript declarations and local SonarQube compatibility. It is preferred over raw scanner shell execution, unmaintained sonar-scanner wrappers, and ad hoc scanner protocol calls.
composedProof.webApiBoundary: sonarqube-web-api-no-maintained-js-admin-sdk-exception; Web API calls are confined to adapters/assurance for readiness, temporary credential lifecycle, quality gate readback, issue and hotspot query, and cleanup.
composedProof.serviceReadinessProof: bounded Web API retry reaches UP against local Compose SonarQube
composedProof.scannerExecutionProof: official SonarSource npm scanner submits a synthetic TypeScript project
composedProof.qualityGateProof: quality gate status readback returns OK for the synthetic project
composedProof.unresolvedIssueHandlingProof: unresolved issue query path exercised and value-free count bucket recorded
composedProof.securityHotspotTreatmentProof: security hotspot query path exercised and value-free count bucket recorded; human review workflow remains deferred
composedProof.operatorAccessProof: authenticated local API validation proves operator credential boundary; UI clickthrough is not claimed
composedProof.retentionCleanupProof: temporary project deletion and temporary credential revocation are checked
composedProof.redactionProof: scanner stdout and stderr are suppressed; proof output contains endpoint refs and hashes only
